sharedPrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: illustrative food photograph for a home cooking recipe catalog. Photorealistic editorial food photo, landscape 3:2. Simple homemade snack on light ceramic plate or bowl, 45 degree overhead view, soft daylight, neutral light stone tabletop. Natural colors, real homemade textures, all important food in central 80 percent with comfortable margins for responsive cropping. No people, hands, utensils, labels, logos, watermarks, packaging or decorative props. Show only named ingredients without extra garnish or side dishes. Wooden food skewers allowed only when explicitly requested.

images.subject: Small bowl of rustic egg and canned tuna spread, clearly visible chopped fully hard boiled egg white and firm yellow yolk, flaky canned tuna, modest thick white yogurt dressing and tiny dill flecks. Two small plain untoasted bread slices alongside on the same plate. No raw egg, mayonnaise, tomato, lemon wedge or lettuce.

Small bowl of coarse fork-mashed canned green pea and white feta spread with tiny dill flecks, some soft pea pieces still visible. Two small plain untoasted bread slices on the same plate. No hummus, avocado, mint leaves, lemon garnish, oil drizzle or extra vegetables.

Six short plain wooden food skewers on a plate, each holding one thick cucumber half slice, one small whole red cherry tomato, one pitted green olive and one modest firm white feta cube. Cold simple homemade appetizer. No basil, dressing, bread or other ingredients.

Four small baked thin lavash rolls filled with white cottage cheese and finely grated apple with cinnamon. Light golden lavash surface, one roll cut to reveal soft filling. No powdered sugar, syrup, berries, nuts, egg wash or extra fruit.

Eight medium baked button mushroom caps on a plate filled with cottage cheese, finely chopped cooked mushroom stems, tiny dill flecks and modest melted pale yellow cheese. Soft brown cooked mushrooms with lightly golden filling. No meat, breadcrumbs, tomato, sour cream or extra garnish.

Two whole medium baked red apples with a small hollow in the center filled with raisins, finely chopped walnuts and cinnamon. Soft slightly wrinkled intact apple skins, modest natural juice on the plate. No caramel, honey, ice cream, whipped cream, loose garnish or decorative cinnamon sticks.

Eight small soft white cottage cheese balls with finely diced dark prune pieces, lightly coated in finely chopped walnuts, on a small plate. Rustic soft texture, not chocolate truffles. No coconut, cocoa, powdered sugar, mint, berries or extra garnish.

Eight thick rounds of baked young green zucchini topped with a thin red tomato slice and modest melted pale yellow cheese, tiny oregano flecks. Juicy soft baked vegetable rounds on a plate. No dough, breadcrumbs, salami, basil leaves or extra garnish.
